title: AI-Powered Business Analytics: Turn Data Into Competitive Advantage

facts.fact: Gartner predicts that by 2025, AI analytics will be involved in over 60% of business decisions.
facts.quote: Gartner predicts that by 2025, AI analytics will be involved in over 60% of business decisions, up from 35% in 2023.

facts.fact: Gartner's figure for AI analytics involvement in business decisions was 35% in 2023, which the page cites as the baseline for its 2025 forecast.
